keyFindings.description: The 15→16 renumber's sentence sweep is incomplete, and the repository's own rule for a renumber (docs/solutions/legion/daemon-api-contract-collision-renumber-…md:103-110) puts the sweep in the renumber's commit. Five published or agent-read sentences still name 15 for this branch's shape: the plugin README says the gate wants 15 (the npm README of a package declaring 16); the LEGION-462 upgrade runbook offers an operator two numbers ('15 for the shared issue pod, 16 once the capability report lands beside it') where every checkout that carries the sentence is at 16, and an operator who takes 15 is refused by 409/boot gate after the runbook's destructive steps; the CHANGELOG's Unreleased section says 'needs this release beside a daemon at 15' (main's LEGION-462 text, now a forward claim about the release being cut at 16 — keep the entry's opening verbatim, fix only that clause); and two retro notes record the capabilities shape at 15, one stating '15, which no release had shipped' — false now, 8.3.0 shipped 15 without capabilities, which is why this round renumbered. Fix: 16 at each (the runbook may instead point at the file alone), one commit.
